snippet.title: Summon a Sweetheart | All 10 ENDINGS | No Commentary
snippet.description:
❤️‘Summon a Sweetheart’ is a short visual novel-esque game, about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all! 

In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result. 

Enjoying the video? Don't forget to LIKE ❤️, COMMENT 💬, and SUBSCRIBE 🔔 for more horror gameplay!  It helps us grow and bring more awesome indie horror content! 💀🔥
